# Draft:Laos Billie Jean King Cup team

}}
The Laos Billie Jean King Cup team represents Laos in Billie Jean King Cup tennis competition and are governed by the Lao Tennis Federation.  They currently compete in the Asia/Oceania Zone of Group II.
History
Laos competed in its first Billie Jean King Cup in 2022.  Their best result was finishing first in their Group III event in 2025 and won promotion to compete in Group II next year.
